speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This came home in a paper, Susanna. A penny. It was not opened on the way.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I can smell it through the paper. Thank you. I was not required at the market, and the penny arrived anyway.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I carried it and I did not open it. Opening would have made three, and I had counted to two.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mine is already eaten. One penny. The laugh at the Cross was a separate purchase, and it is spent.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Wash your thumbs before you touch a cloth. Susanna, the paper is thine to unfold when thou art ready, and not before the board is clear.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I will wait until the board is clear. A penny that survives the lane is a serious penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It survived. That is the whole of the report.
